evals.name: fx-report
evals.prompt: Make me a small command-line tool in this folder that reads a CSV of transactions (columns: date as YYYY-MM-DD, amount, currency) and prints the total spent per month, converted to EUR. Exchange rates come from the Frankfurter API (GET https://api.frankfurter.app/latest?from=EUR returns {"rates": {"USD": 1.08, ...}}). Add tests. Note: the API isn't reachable from this machine, so don't try calling it for real.

checks.text: Project set up with uv (pyproject.toml and uv.lock)
Each new runtime dependency is reported with its license
checks.cmd: python3 -c "import tomllib,re,os,sys; d=tomllib.load(open('pyproject.toml','rb')).get('project',{}).get('dependencies',[]); r=open(os.environ['REPORT']).read(); sys.exit(any(not re.search(re.split(r'[<>=!~\\[ ;]',x)[0]+r'.*licen[sc]e', r, re.I|re.S) for x in d))"

evals.name: legacy-discount
evals.prompt: Add discounts to the shop: orders with a subtotal over 100 EUR get 10% off, and VIP customers get 15% off instead (never both). The discount applies before tax in OrderService.total. Add tests.

evals.name: retry-backoff
evals.prompt: The forecast API sometimes answers 503 or times out. Make fetch_forecast retry those with exponential backoff (up to 3 attempts), but fail right away on other errors. Add tests.

hidden_tests.text: Hidden behaviour tests pass: retries 503 and timeouts, no retry on 404, at most 3 attempts

checks.text: The test suite doesn't really sleep through the backoff (under 5 s)

evals.name: dedupe-function
evals.prompt: I get event records as JSON: a list of dicts with keys id, updated_at (ISO 8601 string, with timezone) and payload. Write a function in dedupe.py that removes duplicates by id, keeping the most recently updated one. Add a test.

hidden_tests.text: Hidden behaviour tests pass: keeps the latest record by real time, across time zones

checks.text: dedupe.py stays plain functions (no class, Protocol or dataclass; a TypedDict is fine)
checks.cmd: python3 -c "import ast,sys; t=ast.parse(open('dedupe.py').read()); sys.exit(any(isinstance(n,ast.ClassDef) and 'TypedDict' not in [ast.unparse(b) for b in n.bases] for n in ast.walk(t)))"
